description: [Requires sign-in] Ask benchmark personal-agent personas what they think of a brand and whether they would recommend it for a category. Personas A to E are ARC benchmark personas named by how they shop: A always-on errands, B errands by text, C researches on its own computer, D works toward a goal, E self-hosted. None of them is a consumer AI product or a live consumer-product session. Persona C runs on a Grok model via API. It is not the real Grok read-back on a scan and it is not the agent-rails HTTP check. What Grok tells shoppers on a scan is a real model call via API, checked against the store's pages, not the consumer Grok app. All five cart attempts, Grok included, are ARC browser cart tests. Returns, per persona: mentioned, recommended, which competitors were recommended instead, sentiment, and short quotes, plus next steps. Limited to 8 runs per workspace per day and 12 per network. Free workspaces also share a site-wide daily cap so unpaid runs cannot drain the model budget.

category.description: Product category a shopper would ask about, e.g. running shoes.

competitors.description: Optional competitor brand names to watch for in the answers.

name: ask_agents_about_brand
